issue.description: Nomenclature creation fails due to field mapping error
issue.root-cause: The 'code' field from the form is not being included in the API request payload

analysis.frontend-field: formData.code (collected from form but not sent to API)

solution.step: Add 'code' field to requestData object in the handleSubmit function
Update the requestData mapping to include: code: formData.code
Ensure field names match the backend schema (code, name, account_name, bill_name, operation)
Test creating a new nomenclature with all required fields
